title: GLUB (GIS Looking Under the Blue): seagrass and shallow seabed mapping for QGIS

creators.name: Ibarra-Marinas, Daniel
creators.affiliation: Facultad de Ingeniería y Ciencias, Universidad Autónoma de Tamaulipas

creators.name: García-García, Ana Mónica de Jhesú
creators.affiliation: Facultad de Ingeniería y Ciencias, Universidad Autónoma de Tamaulipas

creators.name: Mora-Olivo, Arturo
creators.affiliation: Facultad de Ingeniería y Ciencias, Universidad Autónoma de Tamaulipas

description: QGIS plugin to map seagrass meadows and shallow benthic habitats from satellite imagery: download and preparation of Sentinel-2 surface reflectance, Landsat 4-9 Collection 2 Level-2 import, ACOLITE import or any multiband reflectance raster, sunglint correction, median composites with a water-clarity ranking of the scenes, Lyzenga depth-invariant index, optional bottom texture, supervised classification with a three-state depth mask (bottom visible, not visible, too deep), spatial-block validation, stratified random validation points, error-corrected areas (Olofsson et al., 2014), change between two class maps and export of the maps to polygons.
